steps.title: Set the take-profits in the app
steps.text: AMD TP $683.18 and TTWO TP $266.39 (+25% from cost). The stops stay at $498 and $190. Rule 3: no line without both.

steps.title: No trades until Monday, your commitment
steps.text: The app's stops and take-profits still act on their own. A fill there is the plan, not a breach.

steps.title: The first v6 scan
steps.text: The desk runs the dip rule on the watchlist at Friday's close, writes a 5-line study for each signal, and sends Monday's buy list before the open. Today's cash funds 2 buys of $400 above the $150 floor.

steps.title: TTWO sits just above its $190 stop
steps.text: A 2027 GTA VI delay rumor is going around (unconfirmed; Xbox still lists 11/19, preload 11/12). An official delay is a thesis break: sell at the next open. Otherwise the stop decides. Never lower it.

steps.title: AMD reports after the close
steps.text: Options imply about ±9.7%. Under v6 the $498 stop and the $683.18 take-profit decide; there is no pre-report rule.

steps.title: Deposit the October $200
steps.text: It goes to cash, because VOO is at its 35% target.

rules: Never lower a stop, and never remove one
Never re-buy a name in the session its stop fired
Never hold a line without its SL and TP in the app
Never buy a dip without a signal
The instinct lost 3–5× more in the bust test
At most 2 open lines per theme
Never more than $400 a buy, a 6th slot, or cash under $150
AMD $500 in one fill; cash at 0.8%
No buy in the 3 sessions before earnings, or on an FOMC day
Every buy has a 5-line study first
October's overrides were all buys without the desk
